#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Copyright (c) 2026 cachy-asahi contributors.
"""Read-only provenance check; never copy files or execute the runtime helper."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import sys


def digest(path):
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError(f"missing or nonregular input: {path}")
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--source", choices=("setup", "repository", "repository-doc"), default="setup",
                        help="select an existing pinned copied source")
    parser.add_argument("--canonical", type=Path, help="explicit canonical source, including outside the checkout")
    parser.add_argument("--copy", type=Path, help="packaged source; provenance and LICENSE are read beside it")
    parser.add_argument("--license", type=Path, help="canonical project license; defaults to repository LICENSE")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    here = Path(__file__).resolve()
    root = here.parents[3] if len(here.parents) > 3 else None
    sources = {"setup": ("cachy-asahi-setup", None),
               "repository": ("cachy-asahi-repository", "scripts/repository/enroll.py"),
               "repository-doc": ("repository-enrollment.md", "docs/repository-enrollment.md")}
    packaged_name, required_path = sources[args.source]
    copy = args.copy or here.with_name(packaged_name)
    try:
        record = json.loads(copy.with_name("source-provenance.json").read_text())
        if not isinstance(record, dict):
            raise ValueError("provenance must be a JSON object")
        license_sha256 = record.get("license_sha256")
        if args.source != "setup":
            additional = record.get("additional_sources")
            if not isinstance(additional, dict):
                raise ValueError("missing pinned additional sources")
            record = additional.get(args.source)
            if not isinstance(record, dict):
                raise ValueError("missing pinned additional source")
            record = dict(record, license_sha256=license_sha256)
        name = record.get("canonical_path")
        if (not isinstance(name, str) or "\\" in name
                or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in name.split("/"))
                or PurePosixPath(name).is_absolute()
                or (required_path is not None and name != required_path)
                or (required_path is None and (PurePosixPath(name).parts[:2] != ("scripts", "setup")
                    or len(PurePosixPath(name).parts) < 3))):
            raise ValueError("unsafe canonical_path for selected source")
        if record.get("packaged_source") != packaged_name:
            raise ValueError("unexpected packaged_source in provenance")
        for key in ("sha256", "license_sha256"):
            if not isinstance(record.get(key), str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", record[key]):
                raise ValueError(f"invalid provenance {key}")
        if root is None and (args.canonical is None or args.license is None):
            raise ValueError("cannot infer repository root; provide --canonical and --license")
        canonical = args.canonical or root / name
        if args.canonical is None and not canonical.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
            raise ValueError("canonical_path resolves outside the repository")
        license_path = args.license or root / "LICENSE"
        for label, path, expected in (
            ("canonical helper", canonical, record["sha256"]),
            ("packaged helper", copy, record["sha256"]),
            ("canonical license", license_path, record["license_sha256"]),
            ("packaged license", copy.with_name("LICENSE"), record["license_sha256"]),
        ):
            if digest(path) != expected:
                raise ValueError(f"{label} differs from pinned provenance: {path}")
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        print(f"FAIL: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print("PASS: canonical and packaged helper/license bytes match pinned provenance")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Copyright (c) 2026 cachy-asahi contributors.
"""Temporary-fixture tests; never launch a helper or write caller configuration."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest


CHECKER = Path(__file__).with_name("check-sync.py").resolve()


class SyncTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="cachy-asahi-sync-")
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name)
        self.canonical = self.root / "scripts/setup/helper.py"
        self.copy = self.root / "packages/settings/cachy-asahi-setup/cachy-asahi-setup"
        for path in (self.canonical, self.copy):
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(b"raise RuntimeError('the checker must never execute this helper')\n")
        self.license = self.root / "LICENSE"
        self.license.write_bytes(b"fixture license\n")
        self.copy.with_name("LICENSE").write_bytes(self.license.read_bytes())
        self.record = {
            "canonical_path": "scripts/setup/helper.py",
            "packaged_source": "cachy-asahi-setup",
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(self.canonical.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "license_sha256": hashlib.sha256(self.license.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        }
        self.write_record()

    def write_record(self):
        self.copy.with_name("source-provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps(self.record))

    def run_check(self, success=True, default=False, source="setup"):
        checker = CHECKER
        arguments = ["--canonical", str(self.canonical), "--copy", str(self.copy), "--license", str(self.license)]
        if default:
            checker = self.copy.with_name("check-sync.py")
            checker.write_bytes(CHECKER.read_bytes())
            arguments = []
        arguments += ["--source", source]
        env = dict(os.environ, HOME=str(self.root / "home"), XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(self.root / "config"),
                   XDG_DATA_HOME=str(self.root / "data"), XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(self.root / "cache"),
                   PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
        before = {path: path.read_bytes() for path in self.root.rglob("*") if path.is_file()}
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", str(checker), *arguments],
                                cwd=self.root, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0 if success else 1, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("PASS:" if success else "FAIL:", result.stdout + result.stderr)
        self.assertFalse(list(self.root.rglob("__pycache__")))
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "home").exists())
        self.assertEqual(before, {path: path.read_bytes() for path in self.root.rglob("*") if path.is_file()})
        return result.stderr

    def test_explicit_and_default_success(self):
        self.run_check()
        self.run_check(default=True)

    def test_canonical_drift(self):
        self.canonical.write_bytes(b"drift\n")
        self.assertIn("canonical helper", self.run_check(False))

    def test_packaged_drift(self):
        self.copy.write_bytes(b"drift\n")
        self.assertIn("packaged helper", self.run_check(False))

    def test_missing_inputs(self):
        for path in (self.canonical, self.copy, self.license, self.copy.with_name("LICENSE"),
                     self.copy.with_name("source-provenance.json")):
            original = path.read_bytes()
            path.unlink()
            self.run_check(False)
            path.write_bytes(original)

    def test_stale_hashes(self):
        for key in ("sha256", "license_sha256"):
            original = self.record[key]
            self.record[key] = "0" * 64
            self.write_record()
            self.run_check(False)
            self.record[key] = original
        self.write_record()

    def test_license_drift(self):
        for path in (self.license, self.copy.with_name("LICENSE")):
            original = path.read_bytes()
            path.write_bytes(b"different grant\n")
            self.run_check(False)
            path.write_bytes(original)

    def test_unsafe_paths(self):
        for name in ("/scripts/setup/helper.py", "../scripts/setup/helper.py", "scripts/setup/../helper.py",
                     "scripts/setup", "scripts//setup/helper.py", "scripts/setup/./helper.py", "scripts\\setup\\helper.py", "other/helper.py"):
            self.record["canonical_path"] = name
            self.write_record()
            self.assertIn("unsafe canonical_path", self.run_check(False))

    def test_default_symlink_escape(self):
        outside = self.root / "outside.py"
        outside.write_bytes(self.canonical.read_bytes())
        self.canonical.unlink()
        # The synthetic repository is a subdirectory of this fixture.
        repo = self.root / "repo"
        package = repo / "packages/settings/cachy-asahi-setup"
        package.mkdir(parents=True)
        for name in ("LICENSE", "source-provenance.json", "cachy-asahi-setup"):
            (package / name).write_bytes(self.copy.with_name(name).read_bytes())
        (repo / "LICENSE").write_bytes(self.license.read_bytes())
        target = repo / "scripts/setup/helper.py"
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        target.symlink_to(outside)
        self.copy = package / "cachy-asahi-setup"
        self.assertIn("outside the repository", self.run_check(False, default=True))

    def test_additional_pinned_sources_and_drift(self):
        for source, packaged, canonical in (
            ("repository", "cachy-asahi-repository", "scripts/repository/enroll.py"),
            ("repository-doc", "repository-enrollment.md", "docs/repository-enrollment.md"),
        ):
            with self.subTest(source=source):
                original_copy, original_canonical = self.copy, self.canonical
                self.copy = self.copy.with_name(packaged)
                self.canonical = self.root / canonical
                self.canonical.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                self.canonical.write_bytes(b"raise RuntimeError('read-only source check')\n")
                self.copy.write_bytes(self.canonical.read_bytes())
                entry = {"canonical_path": canonical, "packaged_source": packaged,
                         "sha256": hashlib.sha256(self.canonical.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
                self.record["additional_sources"] = {source: entry}
                self.write_record()
                self.run_check(source=source)
                self.run_check(source=source, default=True)
                self.copy.write_bytes(b"packaged drift\n")
                self.assertIn("packaged helper", self.run_check(False, source=source))
                self.copy.write_bytes(self.canonical.read_bytes())
                self.canonical.write_bytes(b"canonical drift\n")
                self.assertIn("canonical helper", self.run_check(False, source=source))
                self.canonical.write_bytes(self.copy.read_bytes())
                entry["canonical_path"] = "scripts/setup/wrong.py"
                self.write_record()
                self.assertIn("unsafe canonical_path", self.run_check(False, source=source))
                self.copy, self.canonical = original_copy, original_canonical
                del self.record["additional_sources"]
                self.write_record()

    def test_bad_provenance(self):
        for key, value in (("packaged_source", "other"), ("sha256", "bad"), ("license_sha256", None)):
            original = self.record[key]
            self.record[key] = value
            self.write_record()
            self.run_check(False)
            self.record[key] = original
        for text in ("{", "[]"):
            self.copy.with_name("source-provenance.json").write_text(text)
            self.run_check(False)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
